aircraftList.description:
Configures the list of aircraft.

Each aircraft has a CID, callsign, position, direction, altitude, speed, and display options. CID and callsign may omitted and they'll be randomly generated. There are multiple ways to define direction and speed:

	Direction: "heading", "track", or "directFix", where "directFix" is a position on the map.
	Speed: "tas", "ias" or "mach".

startTimeMins.description: Time at the beginning of the simulation in minutes.

mode.description:
Simulator mode.
	"normal": Uses the aircraft list and other settings defined in config.json (this file).
	"separation_practice": Separation Practice mode. Uses random aircraft and settings defined in separation-practice-config.json.
	"auto_position": Automatically positions Aircraft 1 south of Aircraft 0 such that they will pass at 5 NM separation. Normally, Aircraft 0 should be placed at (0, 0) on a heading, and Aircraft 1 should be placed at (0, 0) on a 360 track."

atmosphere.description:
Configures the atmosphere.

Sea level temperature affects how ias and mach change with altitude. Currently, all altitudes are treated as flight levels, so sea level pressure has no effect.

seaLevelTemp.description: Sea level temperature in ºC. Standard atmosphere is 15.

seaLevelPressure.description: Sea level pressure in inHg. Standard atmosphere is 29.92.

from.description: Direction from which wind is coming in degrees.

alt.description: Altitude in hundreds of feet MSL.

aircraftDisplay.description:
Data block display options. All of these are optional.
	color: JavaScript color string.
	halo: true/false.
	haloRadiusNm: radius of halo in NM.
	showDatablock: true/false.
	datablockSlot: numpad direction of data block.

color.description:
Must be a valid JavaScript color string. Ex:

	red
	#00ff00
	rgb(0,0,255)
